create_FusedMoEWithLoRA: create a FusedMoEWithLoRA layer that wraps a base FusedMoE layer with LoRA adapters for efficient fine-tuning
create_FusedMoE3DWithLoRA: create a FusedMoE3DWithLoRA layer for models like GPT-OSS with interleaved gate and up projection weights
initialize_lora_weights: initialize LoRA weights by calling create_lora_weights with max_loras and LoRAConfig parameters
set_lora_adapter: set LoRA adapter weights at a given index by providing lora_a and lora_b weight tensors
check_layer_replaceability: check if a FusedMoE layer can be replaced with a LoRA variant using can_replace_layer
